items.description: Adopt --locked in CI: add --locked to cargo build/test/clippy/check/run invocations against this repo's crates in .github/workflows/*.yml (root crate and pyo3 crate where present; NOT tool-install steps like cargo install), so lockfile/manifest consistency becomes a regression gate — both Cargo.lock files are tracked as of commit 09d90bc. Keep YAML valid; change nothing beyond adding --locked (no toolchain or action-version changes). Verify with grep proof that every in-repo cargo invocation carries --locked plus a YAML syntax check. Scope: .github/workflows/ only.

Triage the 18 open v1.0 Phase-04 review findings in .planning/milestones/v1.0-phases/04-benchmark-validation/04-REVIEW-DISPOSITION.md (path per STATE.md — verify live): classify each as fix-now / defer / already-fixed / wont-fix with a one-line rationale; CR-02 is already recorded fixed in MILESTONES.md. Apply only trivial docs/examples-level corrections in place; for code-level findings (IN-06/07/08/09 harness/test code) record disposition + recommended follow-up without changing behavior. Update the disposition document to reflect the triage. Scope: .planning/ disposition docs + trivial docs/examples fixes only; no src/ behavior changes.

Normalize the MSRV/Python version policy inconsistency flagged in .claude/CLAUDE.md: Python floor says 3.10+ in CLAUDE.md/docs but pyo3/pyproject.toml requires >=3.11 — align documentation to the binding >=3.11 constraint (do NOT lower pyproject.toml); add rust-version = "1.80" to [package] in both Cargo.toml and pyo3/Cargo.toml to enforce the documented Rust MSRV. Verify cargo build (root) and cargo check --manifest-path pyo3/Cargo.toml still pass. Scope: the two Cargo.toml manifests + version-policy statements in docs (CLAUDE.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md, README/INSTALL where they state a floor); no source changes.

Clean up nightly-cargo unused_dependencies manifest warnings (root: chrono, inquire; pyo3: pyo3-build-config): FIRST verify actual usage — grep src/ for chrono and inquire use (CLAUDE.md lists chrono for metadata timestamps, inquire for interactive file selection) and pyo3/build.rs for pyo3-build-config. Remove a dependency only if genuinely unused; if used, keep it and record why the warning is a false positive. If any dep is removed, refresh the affected tracked Cargo.lock and verify cargo build + cargo test + cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings (root) and cargo check --manifest-path pyo3/Cargo.toml. Scope: Cargo.toml manifests + Cargo.lock files; no source changes.
